QuestInfo.name: Partnership
QuestInfo.0: With the trust of the Sand Bandits earned, it was time to go after the Goddess Teardrop! Alpha and Beta headed to #p2420007# to get things rolling.
QuestInfo.1: #p2420007# sent the duo to speak with with his leader, #p2420010#.
QuestInfo.2: The Sand Bandits were completing their plans for the raid on the queen's castle. Alpha and Beta would have to wait, but things were looking up...

0.0: Hey, you passed the tests? I guess we're officially on the same team now! Our leader's gonna want to meet you. Why don't you go introduce yourselves?

1.0: I'm glad you brought the fabric! I actually failed this task three times when I tried it...
